item.title: Tomb Raider's 2027's Return Looks Stunning in New Official Footage
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis' new 30th anniversary trailer reveals classic moments from 1996's Tomb Raider in dazzling remake footage.
item.content:encoded: The original Tomb Raider game celebrated its 30th anniversary this weekend, marking the 3D platforming adventure's release on Sega Saturn — yes, it came to Sega's doomed 3D console before its PlayStation and PC release a month later. To mark the occasion, developers Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog, and publisher Amazon Game Studios, revealed a new look at the game originally meant to celebrate that milestone: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis.

item.title: Overwatch Co-Creator Pushes The Legend of California's Early Access Release To 2027
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: Jeff Kaplan's The Legend of California has shifted its early access launch from 2026 to 2027
item.content:encoded: Former Overwatch developers Jeff Kaplan and Tim Ford are currently working on a survival game called The Legend of California at their new studio Kintsugiyama. While the game was previously slated for a Steam Early Access release in 2026, a new r/pcgaming Reddit AMA affirmed it has been pushed back to 2027.

item.title: Elden Ring Has Quietly Become A24's Most Expensive Movie Yet
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: A new report indicates that A24's Elden Ring adaptation from Alex Garland has a blockbuster budget higher than Marty Supreme's
item.content:encoded: It's been a while since we've gotten any official updates on A24's Elden Ring movie, but a new report has revealed that the film has a massive budget. Elden Ring is certainly more expensive than any other movie the Backroomsstudio has made before, so it'll be A24's first true blockbuster.

item.title: The Most Broken D&D Item Keeps Ruining Games. Here Are 3 Ways to Fix It
item.dc:creator: Francesco Cacciatore
item.description: One of the most common magic items in D&D is way overpowered for its cost, but here are three easy ways to fix it.
item.content:encoded: Magic items are an important component of the Dungeons & Dragons experience; collecting and using wondrous artifacts is a given in a role-playing game of heroic fantasy. This is why, in D&D, every character class has access to magic items, starting at the very first level. However, one of these items is so powerful that it can easily turn the game’s balance upside down.

item.title: Nintendo Legend Reveals Super Mario Bros.' Most Surprising Innovation
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: Nintendo designer Shigeru Miyamoto pinpoints the NES game's most notable invention, which remains unique 41 years after the original Super Mario Bros.
item.content:encoded: The original side-scrolling Super Mario Bros. is widely considered to be one of the best games of all time, and the list of reasons justifying that assertion is long. The NES game made Nintendo into a household name, and Mario into a media icon as recognizable as Mickey Mouse. The 1985 video game helped bring games into the mainstream, and it defined platforming as a video game genre. Super Mario Bros. remains one of the best-selling games of all time. Yet if you ask series creator Shigeru Miyamoto, none of these things truly capture SMB's biggest contribution to the world of video games.

item.title: BioWare's Closure Is Just the Tip of the Iceberg
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: The Mass Effect and Dragon Age studio being shuttered by EA is a sign of a slow-motion industry crash that hasn't peaked
item.content:encoded: We're in the middle of an outpouring of mourning for the studio, and for the Mass Effect Universe we never got. BioWare's talented developers will hopefully all go on to great things elsewhere, and many already have. (Who's looking forward to Exodus?) Maybe Mass Effect and Dragon Age will return; in this age of zombie IP, it seems a safe bet that they will. What's really lost at a moment like this, though, is institutional knowledge and culture, the malleable but enduring practices and principles that survive the departure of founders and team leads and are nurtured by new hands. It's a terrible loss.

item.title: Vincent Price Is the Weirdest Serial Killer Ever in this '70s Cult Classic
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: The Abominable Dr. Phibes is a campy horror movie about an organist who murders surgeons
item.content:encoded: We are 10 minutes into The Abominable Dr. Phibes, and nobody has spoken a word. Robert Fuest’s 1971 horror film is a surreal, kitsch, and intentionally funny murder-museum of a movie. But it's also dreamlike and deeply strange in a way that lingers after you've watched it.
